comments.author: idea-review-repo
comments.body:
Feasibility judgement delivered: feasibility.md at d60e93f. Verdict: FEASIBLE as planned — the settled data recipe (RandomState(0), linspace(0,10,40), one normal(0,0.5,40) draw), OLS with intercept, and two-sided Student-t 95% intervals (s^2 = RSS/38, df = 38, t_crit = 2.0244) satisfy every requirement of the objective; one scatter-plus-fit figure completes it. No required change.

Evidence: smoke run here (numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, both installed from PyPI without issue) executes the full recipe in ~1 s and deterministically; intervals are well-defined and informative (probe: slope half-width ~0.06, intercept ~0.33). Probe reproduces the delivered figure's displayed 1.952/1.399, so report/figure numerical consistency is achievable; keep your consistency requirement as an acceptance check on experiment-repo's report.md.

Risks (low, none blocking): interval-method drift — bound by stating t/df=38 explicitly in the report; seed/reporting drift — bound by stating the RNG API and single draw; ht-role status/delivery preview failing with HTTP 422/400 here too (environment issue, not a study defect).

Scope limits for the report: intervals are marginal per-coefficient, not simultaneous and not prediction intervals; coverage of true 2 and 1 is a descriptive observation, not a method validation; one realization, no RNG sensitivity required.

Release governance: no venue/report-review/review deliverable is requested by the objective; the otherwise unowned report function is already routed to experiment-repo in the assignment, so no requirement is unowned. No approval owner is configured and none is needed by the plan; if the world still requires an ht-role approve to release, that is a world-configuration matter outside the research positions, not a study defect. I hold feasibility and do not approve. Nothing in the plan waits on this.
